message.content:
Based on the provided image, here is an extreme detailed analysis of the course details hero section design:

### 1. Overall Layout Structure
*   **Layout Type:** Asymmetric two-column layout (Split-screen).
*   **Container Width:** The content is contained within a max-width of approximately **1280px - 1440px**, centered on the screen.
*   **Column Proportions:**
    *   **Left Column (Content):** Occupies roughly **50-55%** of the width. It contains all textual information, metadata, and primary CTAs. Content is left-aligned.
    *   **Right Column (Visual):** Occupies the remaining space. It features a large 3D illustration that overlaps slightly into the center/left area to create depth and visual connection between text and image.
*   **Vertical Alignment:** Both columns are vertically centered relative to each other.

### 2. Background & Patterns
*   **Base Color:** Pure white (`#FFFFFF`) or extremely light gray (`#F8FAFC`).
*   **Background Graphic:** A subtle, abstract organic shape (blob) in a very pale lavender/blue (`#E0E7FF` or `#F3E8FF` with low opacity) sits behind the robot illustration in the bottom-right quadrant.
*   **Decorative Element:** A thick, curved "swoosh" or wave line in a medium purple color (`#8B5CF6`) runs along the bottom edge of the hero section, separating it from the content below.

### 3. Left Column: Detailed Breakdown

**A. Breadcrumb Navigation**
*   **Style:** Simple text chain with chevron separators (`>`).
*   **Font Size:** ~14px (small).
*   **Color:** Gray for parent links (`#6B7280`), **Purple/Indigo** (`#4F46E5`) for the current active page ("AI Prompt Engineering").
*   **Icon:** Home icon at the start (outline style).

**B. Category Badges (Pills)**
*   **Position:** Above the main title.
*   **Shape:** Fully rounded rectangles (Pill shape), `border-radius: 9999px`.
*   **Padding:** ~`8px 16px`.
*   **Items & Colors:**
    *   *Artificial Intelligence:* Light mint green background (`#D1FAE5`), Dark green text (`#059669`). Icon: Brain/Circuit.
    *   *Beginner Friendly:* Light blue background (`#DBEAFE`), Blue text (`#2563EB`). Icon: User/Person.
    *   *Trending:* Light orange/yellow background (`#FEF3C7`), Orange/Brown text (`#D97706`). Icon: Flame/Fire.

**C. Main Title**
*   **Text:** "AI Prompt Engineering"
*   **Font Style:** Bold Sans-Serif (likely Inter or Poppins).
*   **Size:** Very Large (~56px - 64px).
*   **Weight:** ExtraBold / Black (800 or 900).
*   **Color Gradient:** The word "AI Prompt" is dark navy/slate (`#1E293B`), while "Engineering" transitions into a vibrant purple gradient (`#7C3AED` to `#A78BFA`).
*   **Decoration:** A hand-drawn style underline (squiggle) in purple sits beneath "Engineering", adding a playful touch.

**D. Description Text**
*   **Text:** "Master the art of writing effective prompts..."
*   **Size:** ~18px - 20px.
*   **Line Height:** Relaxed (~1.6) for readability.
*   **Color:** Medium Slate Gray (`#475569`).
*   **Max Width:** Constrained to ~600px to prevent lines from being too long.

**E. Metadata Row**
*   **Layout:** Flex row with gap ~24px.
*   **Style:** Small icons + Text.
*   **Details:**
    *   *Rating:* Yellow/Gold stars (`#FBBF24`) + "4.8" (Bold) + "(2,456)" (Gray).
    *   *Students:* Purple user icon + "1800+ students".
    *   *Duration:* Clock icon + "8 Weeks".
    *   *Level:* Chart/Bar icon + "Beginner".
    *   *Icon Color:* Consistent muted purple/indigo (`#6366F1`).

**F. Call-to-Action (CTA) Buttons**
*   **Primary Button ("Enroll Now"):**
    *   **Bg Color:** Vibrant Green (`#10B981` or `#22C55E`).
    *   **Text:** White, Semi-bold.
    *   **Shape:** Rounded rectangle (`border-radius: 12px` or `9999px`).
    *   **Icon:** Graduation cap inside.
    *   **Shadow:** Subtle green drop shadow (`box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)`).
*   **Secondary Button ("Add to Cart"):**
    *   **Bg Color:** White with Light Border (`#E2E8F0`).
    *   **Text:** Dark Slate (`#1E293B`).
    *   **Icon:** Shopping cart.
    *   **Hover Effect:** Likely lifts up or border darkens.

### 4. Right Column: Illustration Analysis
*   **Style:** 3D Claymorphism / Isometric illustration (reminiscent of Spline or high-end Figma 3D plugins).
*   **Subject:** A friendly, white humanoid robot with rounded edges.
*   **Robot Details:**
    *   **Face:** Black visor screen with glowing cyan/blue curved eyes (happy expression).
    *   **Pose:** Right arm raised, index finger pointing up at a floating lightbulb (symbolizing an idea/AI generation).
    *   **Texture:** Matte plastic finish with soft shadows.
*   **Floating Elements (Contextual):**
    *   *Lightbulb:* Yellow/Orange glow above finger.
    *   *App Icons:* Floating rounded squares representing tools:
        *   Teal background: ChatGPT/OpenAI logo swirl.
        *   Purple background: Midjourney sailboat logo.
        *   Yellow background: Code brackets `</>`.
*   **Interactive UI Mockup (Floating Card):**
    *   A translucent white card floats near the robot's chest.
    *   **Header:** "AI Prompt" with sparkle icon.
    *   **Input Field:** Placeholder text "Write a creative marketing headline... |" (cursor blinking).
    *   **Button:** Purple "Generate" button with magic wand icon.
    *   **Video Preview:** A dark rectangle overlaying the bottom right showing a play button and text "Preview this course".

### 5. Spacing & Padding
*   **Section Padding:** Generous vertical padding (~80px - 100px top/bottom).
*   **Internal Spacing:**
    *   Gap between Breadcrumb and Badges: ~16px.
    *   Gap between Badges and Title: ~24px.
    *   Gap between Title and Description: ~20px.
    *   Gap between Description and Metadata: ~32px.
    *   Gap between Metadata and Buttons: ~40px.
    *   Gap between Primary and Secondary Button: ~16px.

### 6. Border Radius (Rounded Corners)
*   **Badges:** Full pill (`9999px`).
*   **Buttons:** High rounding (`12px` - `16px`).
*   **Video Preview Card:** Moderate rounding (`16px`).
*   **Floating AI Prompt Card:** High rounding (`20px`).

### 7. Shadow Styles
*   **Illustration Elements:** Soft, diffused shadows (`box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`). This gives the 3D objects weight without looking harsh.
*   **Floating Cards:** Soft white/purple tinted shadows to make them appear elevated off the background blob.
*   **Buttons:** Minimal shadow for the green CTA; flat/no shadow for the secondary outline button.

### 8. Color Palette Summary
*   **Primary Action:** Emerald Green (`#10B981`)
*   **Accent/Brand:** Indigo/Purple (`#6366F1`, `#8B5CF6`, `#A855F7`)
*   **Text Primary:** Slate 900 (`#0F172A` or `#1E293B`)
*   **Text Secondary:** Slate 500 (`#64748B`)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   White: `#FFFFFF`
    *   Light Mint: `#ECFDF5`
    *   Light Blue: `#EFF6FF`
    *   Light Amber: `#FFFBEB`
    *   Lavender Blob: `#EDE9FE`

### 9. Typography Details
*   **Font Family:** Modern Geometric Sans-Serif (e.g., **Inter**, **Plus Jakarta Sans**, or **Outfit**).
*   **Hierarchy:**
    *   **H1 (Title):** 64px / Weight 800 / Line-height 1.1.
    *   **Body (Desc):** 18px / Weight 400 / Line-height 1.6.
    *   **Metadata:** 14px / Weight 500.
    *   **Badges:** 13px / Weight 600.
    *   **Buttons:** 16px / Weight 600.

This design effectively uses **color psychology** (green for action/go, purple for creativity/AI), **3D visual hierarchy** to guide the eye from text to the interactive demo, and **generous whitespace** to keep the information digestible despite the density of data points.
